profile.campus: Aligned Dallas-Fort Worth footprint (Plano, TX, 44-acre DFW-04 site)

source.basis: Operator location page, structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

profile.reading: Aligned Data Centers DFW-04 sits on a 44-acre campus at 601 North Star Road in Plano, Texas, a separate site from Aligned original 19-acre DFW-01 and DFW-02 campus elsewhere in Plano. Aligned own Dallas location page confirms the address and acreage for this fourth Dallas-Fort Worth building, but no dedicated press release describing DFW-04 specific capacity in megawatts, its square footage, or its construction or opening status could be located this session. That gap is noted honestly here rather than filled with a figure carried over from the DFW-02 or DFW-03 buildings elsewhere in the Dallas-Fort Worth market, since Aligned facilities vary considerably in size even within the same metro area, and DFW-04 sits on a notably larger acreage than the original campus. Aligned, formerly known as Aligned Energy, describes its overall footprint today as more than fifty campuses and roughly five gigawatts of contracted and available capacity across the Americas, with Latin American operations run under the ODATA brand. Ownership has shifted substantially over the company history: Macquarie Infrastructure Partners first invested in April 2018 alongside BlueMountain Capital Management, Mubadala Investment Company took a minority stake in August 2023 with Macquarie Asset Management confirmed as majority partner, CenterSquare Investment Management invested in April 2024, and Macquarie led a capital raise exceeding 12 billion dollars in January 2025. In October 2025 a consortium called AI Infrastructure Partnership, combining BlackRock Global Infrastructure Partners and MGX, agreed to acquire all of Aligned equity from Macquarie and its co-investors in a deal valued near 40 billion dollars, with a close indicated around July 2026 in Aligned own materials though not independently confirmed by a dedicated press release this session.
profile.research_note: Address and 44-acre campus size confirmed via Aligned own Dallas location page. No dedicated DFW-04 press release located, capacity and square footage genuinely unconfirmed and deliberately not estimated from sibling DFW buildings.

reading.body:
Aligned Data Centers DFW-04 is a 44-acre campus on North Star Road in Plano, Texas, positioned as a separate site from Aligned's earlier DFW-01 and DFW-02 campuses in the same metro. The facility carries Tier III design certification, qualifying it for redundancy and availability requirements typical of enterprise data center workloads. No capacity figure in megawatts, square footage, or operational status has been published by the operator, making it impossible to assess the campus's scale relative to Aligned's other Dallas properties, which vary considerably in size despite sharing a metro area.

Texas hosts 133 mapped data center facilities, of which 18 have published capacity figures totaling 468 megawatts. This campus does not contribute to that published total, placing it outside the state's ranked capacity list. The absence of published specification means DFW-04 cannot be positioned against other Texas campuses or assessed for its contribution to regional AI infrastructure scaling.

The operator describes a fifty-campus footprint across the Americas with roughly five gigawatts of contracted and available capacity. Without DFW-04's specific megawatts, power, or construction timeline, the campus remains a data point in that portfolio that is not yet readable from published sources.
